review_method: Authored each exchange and reviewed all nodes and responses against WRITING_GUIDE.md, companion_conversations.CHARACTER and conversation_voice. Traced approach, preference, final stance, follow-up and tradition outcomes. Text cadence review, not recorded voice QA.
review_checks: Every response answers the selected question, observation or decision.
Concrete anecdotes, explanations and jokes are delivered rather than described as having happened.
Player preferences require an explicit choice, with uncertainty and privacy offered.
A one-off activity selection does not silently replace a stored preference.
Each companion keeps her established priorities and at least one competing motive.
Unresolved disagreement is remembered without forced agreement or a friendship penalty.
Resident pairs address each other and make decisions without requiring player arbitration.
Follow-ups include a new result, observation, revision or joke.
Saved history, current preferences and unchosen authoring remain separate.
UI names the action, progress, requirements, current effect and saved status.
continuity_corrections: Removed an unestablished shared-journey memory between Fenna and Rhess. Rhess responds to the story Fenna actually tells in their scene.
Replaced player choice labels that assumed an earlier objection with direct statements the player can make now.
Changed yesterday/tomorrow claims tied to a one-phase follow-up into phase-neutral wording.
Adjusted window and lamp prose so daytime availability does not require visible stars.
Kept Neris’s new cup design as a drawing, without implying an inventory item was crafted.
rules_integration: Every turn saved; revision and turn guards reject stale actions.
Completion rewards only once; privacy and disagreement have the same reward.
Foundation blessing and resident daily bonding cap remain authoritative.
Completed conversations count as outfit shared-memory evidence.
Scoped generated-dialogue context sees reached words and the latest explicit preference.
Full transcript in profile Talk and journal; preference corrections retain earlier records.
